## Summary

What does this PR do? One or two sentences.

## Related issue

Closes # (issue number, if applicable)

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix or correction (incorrect code example, outdated API, inaccurate claim)
- [ ] New content (new schema type, new reference section, new prompt examples)
- [ ] Improvement (clearer explanation, better example, improved structure)
- [ ] Maintenance (link fix, typo, formatting)

| File | Summary |

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The change is accurate. I have verified it against a primary source (linked below).
- [ ] Any TypeScript examples compile without errors.
- [ ] Any JSON-LD examples pass the [Rich Results Test](https://search.google.com/test/rich-results) or [Schema Markup Validator](https://validator.schema.org/).
- [ ] The tone and style match the existing documents (direct, specific, no marketing language).
- [ ] I have updated [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) under `[Unreleased]` with a brief description of the change.

## Sources

Link to any primary sources that support the accuracy of the change (Next.js docs, schema.org, Google Search Central, Web Vitals docs).

Anything you want the reviewer to pay attention to, or any tradeoffs you made.
